column2: ## Load packages (auto-install any that are missing).
## bestNormalize, agricolae, nlme, multcomp and rstatix were declared by the previous
## version but never called; they are dropped so a fresh machine does not install five
## packages this script has no use for.
# emmeans: lmer post-hoc contrasts; broom/broom.mixed: tidy stats output;
# colorspace: lightened violin fills in p2
for (lib in install.lib) install.packages(lib, dependencies = TRUE)
